name: Steel City Metal Inc
old_description: Family owned and operated, Steel City Metal Inc. strives to meet the needs of any commercial, residential, and industrial project with honesty and integrity.
about:
Steel City Metal Inc was founded in 1996 in Westover, Alabama, as a family-owned and operated business. The company operates from a facility on Old Highway 280 in Westover, with an administrative office in Birmingham, serving the Greater Birmingham area and surrounding states.

The shop provides welding, fabrication, powder coating, and sandblasting services. Its welders hold AWS certification, and the team brings over 30 years of combined experience in welding and powder coating. Steel City Metal functions as a full-service general contractor for metalwork, handling structural and decorative welding, custom fabrication for homes and businesses, and electrostatic powder coating cured under heat. The company does not sell raw materials but supplies the materials required for each project.

Customers span commercial, industrial, and residential sectors. Projects range from repairs and maintenance for factories and shops to custom builds such as the 15,000-pound "Inception" sculpture installed on the Birmingham walking trail, a collaboration with sister company SuperiorScape. The firm also serves homeowners seeking decorative metalwork and businesses needing code-compliant fabrication.

The company emphasizes integrity, safety, and communication as its differentiators. Leadership cites a team approach rooted in family ownership, with AWS-certified welders prioritizing safety on every job. Steel City Metal says it was built on delivering the cleanest welds and structurally sound structures while maintaining outstanding customer service and attention to detail.

name: Steel Masters NYC
about:
Steel Masters NYC operates from a fabrication shop in Brooklyn, New York. The company was founded in 1972 and remains owner-operated and family-run, carrying more than five decades of continuous service across the New York City metropolitan area.

The shop produces custom steel and iron fabrications for both structural and architectural applications. Core product lines include sidewalk cellar doors (flat diamond-plate, vented, oversized single-leaf, and vault-gate models), hydraulic Ez Lift cellar door systems, waterproof bulkhead and Ultra Model raised doors, interior and exterior steel staircases (diamond-plate, galvanized grating, switchback, and fire-egress configurations), pipe and parapet railings, welded bar fencing and gates, rodent-resistant garbage bin enclosures (Economaster and heavy-duty commercial models), expanded metal and welded wire mesh for security cages, window guards, and tree-pit guards, fixed roof access ladders (straight, caged, and ships ladders), HVAC roof dunnage, catwalks, mezzanines, outdoor steel decks, and structural steel alterations such as columns, beams, lintels, floor and stair opening closures, floor reinforcing, and steel plate installations. All items are custom-measured in the field, fabricated in the Brooklyn shop, and installed by the company's own crews.

The customer base spans general contractors, property managers, building owners, facilities managers, architects, engineers, co-op and condo boards, restaurant and retail operators, and homeowners of brownstones, townhouses, and rowhouses. Institutional and commercial clients include hospitals, schools, factories, apartment complexes, and government properties throughout the five boroughs, Long Island, and Westchester.

The company emphasizes that the same organization that welds the steel also installs it, allowing it to hold tolerances and stand behind the finished work. Every project begins with a free estimate based on supplied drawings or photos, followed by a site visit for field measurements, a written proposal, and optional shop drawings for a fee. This hands-on, in-house approach has been the operating model since 1972.

name: Stelray Plastic Products Inc
old_description: A Contract Manufacturer of Precision Injection Molds and Molded Products
about:
Stelray Plastic Products Inc is a family-owned contract manufacturer based in Ansonia, Connecticut. The company has been operating for over 50 years, emphasizing American-made production and a full-service approach to precision injection molding and mold building.

The company operates a 42,000-square-foot facility that houses molding, in-house tool making, quality control, warehousing, secondary operations, and offices. Its molding capacity ranges from 22 to 620 tons, supporting conventional and rotary horizontal injection machines capable of insert molding, overmolding, and multi-material molding. Stelray offers rapid prototyping, design-for-manufacturing reviews, and a suite of post-mold secondary operations including ultrasonic welding, pad printing, heat-staking, soldering, assembly, and packaging. Production volumes span from 100 units to 100 million units annually.

Stelray serves a diverse set of industries: aerospace and automotive, consumer appliance, defense and security, electronics and instrumentation, medical and dental, and water and chemical filtration. The company is FDA registered for medical devices and compliant with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) and 21 CFR 820.

Stelray differentiates itself through its family-owned heritage, a full-service in-house tool room, advanced metrology lab with first-article inspection and validation capabilities, and a lean manufacturing philosophy. The company states that its expert engineering staff works with customers to design parts that are both manufacturable and cost-effective from prototype through production.

old_description: Stengel Bros. Inc. offers quality leaf springs, suspension parts, and air ride suspensions by name brand manufactures. We also sell lift axles, truck bumpers, Monroe shocks, . All of our parts and services are guaranteed.
about:
Stengel Bros. Inc. operates from Whitehall Township, Pennsylvania. The company has been in business for over 43 years, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not provided in available sources.

The company distributes a broad range of suspension components including leaf springs, air ride suspensions, lift axles, truck bumpers, shock absorbers, coil springs, helper kits, trailer axles, U-bolts, and wheel centering products. It carries parts from name‑brand manufacturers such as Monroe, Goodyear, Link Manufacturing, Reyco Granning, Hendrickson, Watson & Chalin, and others. Stengel Bros. also offers custom U‑bolt fabrication for non‑standard applications and ships replacement air springs and heavy‑duty springs nationwide via UPS.

Primary customers operate in commercial trucking, trailer manufacturing and repair, light‑truck and SUV aftermarket, RV and motorhome markets, and utility trailer segments. The catalog references specific applications for Mack, Peterbilt, Kenworth, Volvo, Freightliner, International, and Navistar trucks; Reyco, Neway, Fruehauf, Hutch, and Trailmobile trailer suspensions; and Ford, Chevrolet, GMC, Dodge, Toyota, Nissan, Mitsubishi, and Mazda light trucks and SUVs.

Stengel Bros. emphasizes its longevity — over four decades in the industry — and a guarantee on all parts and services. Nationwide shipping on stocked air springs and heavy‑duty springs, plus the ability to produce special U‑bolts to order, are highlighted as key service differentiators.

name: Sterling Furniture Co
old_description: We’re Sterling Furniture Company. Since 1875, we have provided residents of the Wasatch Front a wide range of high quality, customized furniture at accessible prices.
about:
Sterling Furniture Company has operated in Salt Lake City, Utah, since 1875, when master cabinet maker Hans Madsen opened a store on Main Street. The business remains family-owned, now directed by seventh-generation descendants of Madsen, and its flagship location has anchored the Sugar House neighborhood since 1941.

The company retails home furnishings across living room, bedroom, dining room, and office categories, offering customers the ability to customize fabric selections on special orders at no extra charge. It maintains three display floors at its Sugar House showroom and provides delivery throughout the Salt Lake Valley.

Sterling serves residential customers along the Wasatch Front, supplying furniture for private homes rather than commercial or contract markets. Its inventory emphasizes hardwood construction and traditional joinery, with a focus on accessible pricing and flexible payment terms that echo the founder's original installment approach.

The Madsen family frames its differentiation around generational expertise in selecting durable materials and time-honored construction methods, positioning the store as a source for furniture intended to last across generations rather than follow short-lived trends.

about: Sterling Wire & Cable operates from Minneapolis, Minnesota, where it serves as a wire and cable specialist. The company stocks over 15,000 wire and cable products, including categories such as data and communications cable, building wire, hook-up and lead wire, broadcast and AV cable, electronic cable, fire alarm cable, and safety, sound, and security cable. It also offers value-added services: custom cable design, dyeing and striping (28–10 AWG, 1–2 day lead time), custom respooling and coiling, cut-and-strip services, cut-and-labeled tubing, twisting (28–12 AWG, 1–2 week lead time), consolidated shipments, same-day shipping for orders placed before noon, vendor-managed inventory programs, UL/CSA repackaging, and full traceability to the original manufacturer. Sterling serves industries that require specialized cabling, such as access control systems (evidenced by 3M-approved and Solventum-approved cables), data communications, building infrastructure, broadcast and AV, electronics, fire alarm, and security. Its customers include original equipment manufacturers, contractors, and integrators who need both standard and custom cable solutions. The company emphasizes on-time delivery, competitive pricing, and collaborative innovation to create reliable solutions. Differentiators highlighted by Sterling include same-day shipping on stock items, vendor-managed inventory programs, UL and CSA certification for repackaging, and full product traceability.

name: Stickbulb
old_description: LED fixture manufacturer with showroom, studio, and workshop in a converted iron factory
about:
Founded in 2020, Stickbulb operates a 10,000-square-foot showroom, studio, and workshop inside a converted century-old iron factory in Long Island City, New York. The company is organized as Stickbulb LLC and combines design, prototyping, and production under one roof.

Stickbulb designs and manufactures LED light fixtures using salvaged wood sourced from New York City's urban forest — demolition sites, dismantled water towers, and fallen trees, often within a mile or two of the facility. The product line includes modular collections such as Pillar, Pleat, Skybang, Branching Bough, Ray, Chime, and Diamond, offered in standard sizes with custom lengths and configurations. Production relies on local vendors and flat-pack engineering to minimize shipping volume.

The company serves architects, lighting designers, and interior designers on residential and commercial projects across North America. Notable installations include the Copake Lake House in upstate New York (Desai Chia Architecture), the SoLo House in British Columbia (Perkins & Will), the GL1 project (RUX Studios), and 100 Norfolk in Manhattan (ODA). Stickbulb also supplies trade professionals through showrooms and agents.

Stickbulb positions its differentiation around climate-conscious manufacturing. It has been Climate Neutral certified since 2020, tracking, reducing, and offsetting emissions, and became a Certified B Corporation in 2022. The hyper-local supply chain diverts old-growth timber from landfills, while modular flat-pack designs lower the carbon footprint of distribution.

name: Sticks, Inc.
old_description: Sticks Handmade pieces are all one-of-a-kind and created by artisan hands from start to finish. Art & furniture made in America since 1992.
about:
Sticks, Inc. was founded in 1992 in West Des Moines, Iowa. The company began as a studio creating one-of-a-kind handmade art and furniture, with each piece drawn, wood-burned, and painted by artisan hands.

Today Sticks operates a production studio in Des Moines where it manufactures a wide range of home furnishings and accessories, including sculptures, wall plaques, lamps, lazy Susans, furniture such as tables, chairs, beds, and case goods, as well as holiday ornaments and custom heirloom pieces. The process remains entirely handcrafted: designs are hand-drawn, wood-burned, and hand-painted. The company also runs the Sticks Gallery in Des Moines’ Historic East Village, a retail destination opened in 2002 that carries the full Sticks line alongside work from over 150 other American makers. A wholesale program supplies retailers nationwide.

Sticks serves both direct consumers and the trade. Its retail gallery and e‑commerce site sell to individual shoppers seeking gifts, home decor, and personalized heirlooms, while the wholesale channel serves independent retailers, interior designers, and hospitality buyers. Collections span bedroom, dining, entryway, kitchen, living room, and office categories, with themed lines such as Americana, Lake, Mountain, Wine, and Wedding/Anniversary.

The company’s stated distinction is its commitment to storytelling through art: every piece is created from start to finish by artisans in the Des Moines studio, and the custom program lets customers commission furniture and accessories inspired by personal stories, places, or family history. This emphasis on narrative-driven, American-made craftsmanship has defined the brand since its inception.

Stitch N Print, Inc. has operated in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma since its founding in 1974. The company has served the local market and surrounding areas for decades, building a reputation for custom decorated apparel and textile products.

The shop provides a range of decoration services including screen printing (up to seven colors on items such as shirts, jackets, hats, bags, tablecloths, towels, notebooks, and umbrellas), embroidery on similar substrates, team uniform assembly with trim and piping, direct-to-garment printing, sewn banners, vinyl lettering and numbering, and tackle twill custom lettering and numbering. The facility handles both small and large orders, though specific capacity figures are not published.

Stitch N Print serves businesses, schools, sports teams, and organizations throughout the Oklahoma City metro area that need branded apparel, promotional items, and team uniforms. Customers include local companies seeking logoed workwear, athletic programs requiring numbered jerseys, and events needing custom banners.

The company emphasizes on-time delivery and competitive pricing, stating it will “get your job done on time and for less” while maintaining quality and complete customer satisfaction.

name: Stixon Labels
old_description: Stixon Labels is a manufacturer of custom pressure sensitive labels. We produce labels up to 13.75" x 15" in as many...
about:
Stixon Labels operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, where it was established in 1991 by founder Robert W. Chavez. The business traces its roots to 1955 when Chavez began designing and selling labels, adding flexible packaging in 1961 and forming New Mexico Plastics in 1985. Today the company is owned by Chavez’s daughters—Beverly, Julie, Barbara, and Cristina—who grew up in the label manufacturing business and now lead it as a family-owned operation.

The company manufactures custom pressure-sensitive labels and flexible packaging using flexographic printing, producing labels up to 13.75 by 15 inches. It also provides design and artwork services through a computerized art department, foil stamping, and thermal-transfer blank labels. The staff includes press operators with tenures exceeding 30 years, and most employees have been with the company for more than 15 years.

Stixon serves wineries, distilleries, food and beverage producers, and personal-care brands. Its client list includes Gruet Winery and St. Clair Winery in New Mexico, Headframe Spirits in Montana, Dion’s Pizza Salad Dressings, 505 Southwestern Chile & Salsa, El Pinto Chile & Salsa, New Mexico Piñon Coffee, Sombra Professional Therapy Products, and Marble Brewery, along with retail packaging such as foil-stamped shopping bags.

The company emphasizes service as its differentiator, offering creative, cost-effective solutions from design to finished product. Its long-tenured team and family ownership are cited as reasons for consistent quality and responsiveness.
